claims.citation: New York Herald, 1 July 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Ship Pacific, Harris, Havre, 37 days, with mdse and 99
passengers, to Boyd & Hincken. Has had light westerly
winds and fogs since passing the Western Islands.

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 2 July 1866, p. 4, col. 3
New York Herald, 10 June 1866, p. 5, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The Pacific Steam Navigation Company's steamship
Pacific, Captain Wolcott, from the South Coast, arrived
here on the 29th ultimo. She brings dates from Valpa-
raiso to the 10th and Callao 22d of May, and has a very
large number of passengers for Europe and a few for
the United States.
